correctness.rationale: The contact envelope controls global threshold dynamics; at equality it forces y=O(t^-1), z→z0. The exact quotient u=(z-z0)/y obeys a uniformly asymptotically stable linear ODE, so u→Z_prime(0). The reciprocal prevalence derivative tends to K>0, proving both critical limits. The endemic equation is strictly decreasing in y and an implicit-function expansion supplies the same 1/K prefactor. The source Dulac calculation and hyperbolic sink/saddle geometry justify global supercritical convergence. The embedded program independently of the analytic argument corroborates algebraic coefficients and several finite ODE integrations; its finite tests are not infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The explicit one-group equality-threshold inverse-time and contact-defect coefficients, valid for every smooth monotone breaking/creation pair, are not established by the fully inspected original or later multigroup papers. The same coefficient governing the emerging endemic branch is a structurally motivated quantitative correspondence. Prior adaptive SIS special-case stationary formulas and the multigroup strict-subthreshold theorem do not imply the critical trajectory asymptotics; general bifurcation methodology requires an additional actual reduction. Possible uninspected equivalent reductions remain a residual risk, not an identified covering result.
residual_risks: A full-text comparison with Achterberg–Van Mieghem (2022) was not completed; its abstract describes a different stochastic/closure framework.
An equivalent contact-defect center-manifold coefficient might be present in other mathematical epidemiology literature under different notation.
No independent external validation has been conducted.

value.rationale: The natural bifurcation question at R0=1 was left nonhyperbolic/undetermined in the original source. The derived contact-feedback derivative K sharply controls both deterministic critical extinction timescale and the near-threshold endemic burden for a nontrivial entire family of risk-response functions. Its independence from common contact-adjustment speed isolates the meaningful ratio of breaking/creation parameters, providing a quantitative epidemiological interpretation beyond equilibrium existence or a routine single-parameter calculation.
